metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for project management workflows

sharedDependencies.name: _shared
sharedDependencies.description: claude-hook-transport — shared hook dispatch and transport library used by all plugins via [tool.uv.sources] path reference

plugins.name: sandbox
plugins.description: Manage Claude Code sandbox-mode settings.json — write paths, MCP allow rules, network domains, deny rules

plugins.name: worktree
plugins.description: Git worktree management — create, list, and remove worktrees from configured base repositories

plugins.name: proj
plugins.description: Project lifecycle management: init, explore, status, update, todo, report, archive

plugins.name: trello
plugins.description: Trello board, card, and list management via REST API — full CRUD for boards, lists, cards, labels, members, comments, checklists, attachments

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Read-only Jira Server issue and project access via REST API.

plugins.name: hooks
plugins.description: Central MCP-to-MCP hook registry with schema-based param mapping, auto-registration, and recovery

plugins.name: zoxide
plugins.description: Zoxide frecency database integration — boost, remove, and query paths

plugins.name: todoist
plugins.description: Todoist task and project management via REST API — create, complete, update, find, and delete tasks and projects

plugins.name: analyse
plugins.description: Guided code review skill that walks users through features, explains the code, and creates todos for improvements.
